entries.description: Ran the domain-existence sweep BEFORE any Lean work on the Q6.6 forward-error bound. The RTL's own header names two envelopes and says which one is format-dependent, so the check was cheap and decisive. Starting the proof first would have been walking to a destination nobody had checked exists — fourth application of the arm's method.

Both Verilator binaries came out BYTE-IDENTICAL in size, which looks exactly like a -G parameter override that silently failed. Stopped and verified the override in the generated headers (VL_IN16 x_in 11:0 vs 15:0) before trusting a single number. Had it actually failed, the entire sweep would have been one format reported as two.
Scored the prediction as WRONG rather than as substantially right. It got the window's shape and cause correct and the pass/fail verdict backwards; a bar is a bar, and three is at least three.

Caught my own octaves-per-bit slope wrong by 2x BEFORE it was recorded as an interpolation law. 3->7 octaves over +2 FRAC bits is 2 octaves/bit, not 1. The error had already been quoted back to me, so it was propagating. Corrected and then TESTED at two new points rather than asserted — two points cannot detect curvature.

Dissected the prediction miss into a taxonomy (miss-of-model / halt-point hit / miss-of-conversion / win) and identified that forcing a binary call on a straddle manufactures a coin flip and scores it as judgment. Became AMENDMENT 5: MARGINAL with stated bounds.

findings.description: PREDICTION FALSIFIED: predicted W=12 fails the 3-octave bar; it has EXACTLY three and passes. Mechanism right (window straddles the bar, six fractional bits, saturation at the low end), verdict wrong. AI session-prediction record now 1-for-4.

W=16 is the chip candidate, not W=12: 1.6x the area buys 2.3x the usable domain (3 to 7 octaves) and 4x the accuracy. Each pair of fractional bits buys about two octaves. The area sweep alone picked the wrong format; it took the accuracy sweep to choose on evidence.

The octaves/fractional-bit slope is a LAW, not a trend: usable octaves = 2*FRAC - 9, exact at FRAC in {6,8,10,12}, window |b| in [2^-(FRAC-5), 2^(FRAC-4)). Mechanism explains it (each bit extends representability one octave at EACH end). Future format questions interpolate on a measured line instead of a fresh sweep.

W=16 certification classified as RE-INSTANTIATION, not re-derivation: nr_reciprocal_4stage takes the truncation quantum s as a free real; all 16 Q16.16 mentions are docstrings, none in a theorem statement. Zero new proofs. Only LIN_C1/LIN_C2 and the measured seed margin re-derive.
